activity_statements.statement: manufactures and sells the FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring system (CGM) for diabetes patients worldwide
develops and sells cardiac rhythm management and heart failure devices (implantable devices, monitors) for cardiologists and hospitals
manufactures neuromodulation devices (spinal cord stimulators, deep brain stimulators) for patients with chronic pain and movement disorders
produces laboratory-based diagnostics instruments and reagents for hospital and clinical labs globally
manufactures and distributes nutrition products (e.g., Ensure, Similac) for patients and consumers in 160+ countries
sells established branded pharmaceutical products in emerging markets across Africa, Asia, and Latin America

name_reality_gap: Indexed as 'Hospitals and Health Care' — significantly misleading. Abbott does not operate hospitals; it manufactures and sells medical devices, diagnostics instruments, and nutrition products. The company is a medical-device and diagnostics manufacturer that sells to hospitals, not a healthcare provider.
extraction_notes: About page was light on specifics; product page confirmed FreeStyle Libre CGM as lead product. Segment structure and products (Ensure, Similac, cardiac devices) are from well-known public reporting. Many product sub-pages returned 404.
